label: Primary FSGS with APOL1 branch
summary: Bounded circulating-factor/immune primary FSGS and separate APOL1-associated kidney injury branch; excludes other genetic, adaptive, viral and drug-associated FSGS. APOL1-associated disease is not classified as idiopathic primary FSGS.
query: ((TITLE_ABS:"focal segmental glomerulosclerosis" OR TITLE_ABS:"FSGS") AND (TITLE_ABS:primary OR TITLE_ABS:"circulating factor" OR TITLE_ABS:nephrin OR TITLE_ABS:recurrence)) OR (TITLE_ABS:APOL1 AND (TITLE_ABS:podocyte OR TITLE_ABS:channel OR TITLE_ABS:interferon OR TITLE_ABS:inaxaplin))
